listMembers.usage:
let roles: [MemberRole] = [.admin]
let response = try await client.members.listMembers(sort: .asc, role: .admin, roles: roles, region: .eu)

updateMember.usage:
let request = MemberUpdateRequest(role: .admin, kind: .regular)
let response = try await client.members.updateMember(id: 123, request: request)
updateMember.output: Member(id: Int, role: MemberRole, status: MemberStatus, previousStatuses: [MemberStatus]?)
